title: Orgology
equation: Organizational Health = (Structure + Incentives + Feedback Quality + Cultural Coherence) ÷ 4
hook: If the same problem keeps happening with different people, it's not the people. It's how you set things up.
statement: Your company is a system of structure, incentives, and feedback. Design it on purpose from day one.
explainer: Structure and incentives drive most of what people do, so scolding rarely fixes a setup problem. Good feedback loops, like regular reviews and decision logs, hold the whole thing up.
sop: Map who owns which decisions and how feedback flows.
Spot where things misalign or get stuck.
Redesign one piece at a time.
Set simple rituals like goal reviews and retros.
Re-check the design every time headcount doubles.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Structure 6, Incentives 7, Feedback Quality 5, Cultural Coherence 8. (6 + 7 + 5 + 8) ÷ 4 = 6.5. Higher means your setup produces the behavior you want. Lower means willpower is covering for gaps.
question: Name one behavior on your team that bugs you, then the structure that's rewarding it.
closing_statement: Structure shapes behavior faster than culture talk does.
caption:
Principle Nº 311: Orgology
